what: Divides the screen into 10px cells, cells the mouse passes over are filled solid with the accent color and erased linearly over .5s — a stair-stepped pixel tail trails the cursor and vanishes within half a second. The overlay takes no input (pointer-events: none), so you can click through to what is below

options.fade: Duration for cells to disappear (ms), default 500
options.delay: Delay from painting to start of erasing (ms), default 0
options.look: inline: Only inside the attached element instead of the full screen (absolute relative to the parent)

note: The original turns it on only after the intro ends via React state (the first page appears at .3s), and when the phone menu opens it changes the fill to the background color — the consumer can attach data-fx late or change --kf-accent

from.where: Every page (except the values essay) .tb-pixels — original pixel trail (10px cells (pixelSize 10) · fade 500ms linear · #0C50FF · z 1000 · only on pointer fine)
